description: This file implements AVX2-optimized functions for precoding in a wireless communication system, including complex number operations, layer mapping, and precoding application for multiple layers and ports.

classes.name: simd_cf_t
classes.description: Represents a set of complex numbers using AVX2 registers for real and imaginary parts.

methods.name: set1
methods.description: Initializes AVX2 registers with a complex constant.

methods.name: operator*
methods.description: Performs multiplication of interleaved complex numbers with a complex weight.

methods.name: ps_to_cbf16
methods.description: Converts AVX2 complex float register to 16-bit fixed point format.

methods.name: apply_precoding_port
methods.description: Applies precoding weights to input RE buffers and stores the result.

methods.name: from_ci8_to_cf
methods.description: Converts 8-bit fixed point symbols to complex float AVX2 registers.

methods.name: layer2_map_and_ci8_to_cf
methods.description: Maps and converts symbols for two-layer precoding.

methods.name: layer3_map_and_ci8_to_cf
methods.description: Maps and converts symbols for three-layer precoding.

methods.name: layer4_map_and_ci8_to_cf
methods.description: Maps and converts symbols for four-layer precoding.

methods.name: apply_layer_map_and_precoding
methods.description: Performs layer mapping and applies precoding for multiple layers and ports.
